name: RESIZER_F_WOLF_DEAD_HOLD
meaning: HandleMessage sets 1; Update case 0 requires it clear before freezing the Wolf (inferred)

name: RESIZER_F_WOLF_DEAD
meaning: Update: set when the Wolf answers MSG_WOLF_IS_DEAD

name: RESIZER_F_WOLF_FROZEN
meaning: Update: set after msg 0xe froze the Wolf (and for class 0x91), cleared on release

name: RESIZER_F_GROW
meaning: PostLoadInit property; selects anim 1 vs 0 in Update and SetState (inferred)

name: RESIZER_F_EXIT_ONLY
meaning: PostLoadInit property; without it exitObject is read and the model box is used; receives from another Resizer

name: RESIZER_F_TARGET_RESIZED
meaning: Update: set when target accepted MSG_SET_SIZE, cleared after

name: RESIZER_F_RUNTIME_MASK
meaning: Resizer::Reset: flags &= 0xfffff600 (keeps 0x200 GROW and 0x400 EXIT_ONLY); the constant is the complement of the literal (inferred)
